bio: NM is situated inside the spectacular and unique El Vasco shopping mall, which has one floor entirely dedicated to food and dining. This attractive restaurant, whose designer dining space occupies an area called Nastura, features a bar counter that can also be used for dining, and a focus on dishes prepared with top-quality ingredients which reflect the roots and traditions of the Asturias region on every plate. Here, award-winning chef Nacho Manzano employs contemporary techniques that extract the maximum from the ingredients he works with. This is demonstrated on a seasonal tasting menu (choose between the shorter or longer options) that takes guests on a journey through the bountiful meadows, woods and mountains of Cantabria and the family’s market garden in Narbasu.
